items.title: Trump admin. urges Apple not to purchase Chinese memory chips, but this presents a problem

items.title: Micron Stock Closes Above $1,000 After Key Move by Trump Administration
items.summary: Renewed momentum for the memory-chip trade might be boosted by the Trump administration’s rejection of Chinese hardware.  Micron shares closed up 4.1% at $1,011,75.  American depositary receipts of its South Korean rival  SK Hynix  rose 3% to $171.38.
